proposedCreate.summary: Reuse valid safe bootstrap cache during public batch continuation
proposedCreate.description:
## Goal

As a fleet curator, I want interrupted public collection to reuse valid safe page, model-tree and option-definition projections, so continuation does not spend source requests fetching still-valid cached data.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] An unexpired same-context recreated-descriptor continuation reuses page/discover/options and refreshes settings only before the pending solve; the two-candidate fixture makes seven total GETs, with two fresh GETs and three explicit cache hits.
- [ ] Reused safe projections retain original observation/retrieval times, request/response/content hashes and expiry; predecessor bytes, inherited outcomes and configuration IDs remain unchanged.
- [ ] Source and capture guards are restored only after strict validation of the exact safe retained context and candidate definitions; no bootstrap header or secret is retained in checkpoints, reports or caches.
- [ ] Expired safe entries refresh only within the explicit finite allowance with honest per-operation counts; incompatible or corrupt plan/source/tool/request/context evidence is refused without silent mixing or unauthorized traffic.
- [ ] A retained spent solver response remains recoverable without replay, an unspent pending solve executes once, and completed continuation restart adds no source calls.

## Files or areas

- scripts/gcsp/collect-fleet.mjs: createPublicBatchCollector
- scripts/gcsp/collection-session.mjs: createCollectionSession / perform
- scripts/gcsp/public-bmw-source.mjs: publicBmwBatchOperations
- scripts/gcsp/capture-bmw-selection.mjs: publicBmwCompleteSelectionOperations
- server/test/gcsp-bmw-source-batch.test.js: continuation regressions

## Decided

work_item_type: bug
kind: code
severity: Medium

diagnosis: Confirmed by read-only current-code inspection and retained actual two-process evidence; no new execution. createPublicBatchCollector in scripts/gcsp/collect-fleet.mjs:286 copies predecessor cache into continuation.retainedAllocations at 399-406, but createCollectionSession in scripts/gcsp/collection-session.mjs:267 initializes active cache:[]; bootstrap at collect-fleet.mjs:450-452 therefore refetches valid safe entries. The inherited lookup at collect-fleet.mjs:463-474 covers solve only. The historical Phase A safe entries expire on 8 November 2026; Phase B refetched them on 7 November 2026 within seconds, under the same pinned context and matching tree/options hashes. Settings is explicitly cache:false at public-bmw-source.mjs:1077 and should refresh. Simply copying entries is insufficient: collection-session.mjs:335-336 returns cached projections without projectors, while publicBmwBatchOperations (public-bmw-source.mjs:1045-1119) depends on treeQualified, qualifiedDefinitions and definitionsQualified, and publicBmwCompleteSelectionOperations (capture-bmw-selection.mjs:60-82) depends on treeObserved. The future repair must validate retained safe context and restore these guards without persisting capability headers or inventing fresh provenance.

Disposition: explicit root instruction on 7 November 2026 relays the user's defer-nonblocking/get-live direction. Defer this Medium finding for independent later prioritisation/pickup. It is not a build or merge dependency. Original F59 AC4 is neither passed nor waived; In Review is a development-review recommendation and Done is not claimed. No repair is authorized in this pass.

## Out of scope

F58 profile/source qualification; additional live requests; source budget expansion; FUCQ-152 predecessor-fork repair; Story acceptance or Jira transitions; publication or default application activation.

3. Recreate createFleetCollector and its operation descriptors with a new explicit allocation and continuation checkpoint while those entries remain valid.
4. Continue the pending candidate. Inspect per-operation calls, cache hits, original checkpoint bytes and published IDs.

## Expected behaviour

For the unexpired same-context fixture, continuation reuses page/discover/options, refreshes settings because cache:false protects memory-only headers, and issues the pending solve once: two fresh GETs and seven across both phases, with one cache hit for each of page/discover/options. The recreated public continuation has a fresh empty active cache and refetches page/settings/discover/options before its pending solve: five fresh GETs and ten total, with zero bootstrap cache hits.
